about_short_description.short_description: Middle East Specialized Cables is a provider and manufacturer of cables and wires delivering total and complete solutions.

product.name: Power & Control Cables
product.description: Cables designed to transmit electrical power and control signals in various industrial and commercial applications.

product.name: Instrumentation & Process Cables
product.description: Cables used for electronic and digital control, measurement, and monitoring in industrial processes.

product.name: Fieldbus Cables
product.description: Cables that connect field devices to control systems for communication in industrial automation.

product.name: Fire Cables
product.description: Cables engineered to maintain circuit integrity and operation during fire conditions for emergency systems.

product.name: Solar Cables – PV Wires
product.description: Cables used to connect photovoltaic solar panels to electrical systems in solar power installations.

product.name: Cathodic Protection Cables – CP
product.description: Cables used in cathodic protection systems to prevent corrosion of metal structures.
